verdict.rationale: Metronome publishes a structured API reference, served from docs.metronome.com/api-reference with a machine-readable openapi.json. Its own docs page points users to Postman for visually exploring and running API calls without writing code. That gives runnable exploration, but through an external tool rather than in-page interactive docs. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-docs interactive 'try it' console, runnable code examples embedded in the reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Postman is a great way to visually explore the Metronome API without writing code.
